result.summary: The restaurant cards in the 'Fastest near you' row have inconsistent image heights and overlay placement, creating a visually uneven carousel.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Smash Bros Burgers image is shorter than the adjacent cards, so the delivery-time pill sits lower and the row looks uneven.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent image aspect ratio and fixed card height so all thumbnails and overlays align across the carousel.
